title: Security: this customer's stored history contains a prompt-injection attempt -- it never reaches the narrator or changes the outcome

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Carlos -- how can I help today?
Hi, I've been meaning to ask about putting some savings aside, is now a good time?
Absolutely, let me check what's available on your account.
Great, no particular rush, just curious what makes sense.
Makes sense -- let me pull up the right option for you.
Here's what I'd recommend based on your account.
That sounds reasonable, thank you for explaining it clearly.
Glad it's useful -- thanks for calling, have a great day!
